items.en: Dinner course, 8 items — herring with Kamo aubergine and shiso flower in sesame sauce; a clear soup of grilled eel and egg tofu; three-kind sashimi; appetiser plate (tomato in tosa vinegar, taro rikyu-age, aubergine dengaku, conger-eel yahata roll, steeped aubergine, barracuda pressed sushi); saikyo-grilled domestic beef tongue; pike conger and sweet pepper tempura; stone-milled hand-cut soba; warabi dumpling
items.section: Dinner 夜
items.note: 醤油・味噌・天ぷら衣。Soy, miso and tempura batter throughout. Evening adds 10% service and a ¥330 otoshi. Book 2 days ahead.

items.en: Chef's-choice course, the step up from the Daian course
items.section: Dinner 夜
items.note: 内容は当日相談。Contents arranged on request.

items.ja: はじめ蕎麦 せいろ(半盛)
items.en: 'Opening soba' — a half tray of seiro to start the evening with, before the drinking food
items.section: Dinner 夜 — とりあえず
items.note: そばは十割の表記なし＝つなぎ小麦が通例。蕎麦つゆは醤油＝小麦。Soba here is not advertised as juwari, so the noodle almost certainly carries wheat binder, and the dipping tsuyu is wheat soy sauce either way.

items.en: Unazaku — grilled eel and cucumber in a vinegar dressing

items.note: 鰻のたれ＝醤油。Eel glaze is soy.

items.section: Dinner 夜 — 備長炭の炭火焼
items.note: 白焼はたれを使わないが添え醤油・わさび醤油は小麦。蒲焼は醤油だれ。Shirayaki is grilled without tare — ask what comes with it; kabayaki is soy glaze throughout.
